metadata.case_name: LEUNG YIU SHEUNG v. PA LING LOGISTICS CO LTD

injuries.description: fracture of the distal shaft of left tibia and fibula
source: the plaintiff sustained multiple injuries, including injury to his left ankle, left leg and bilateral shoulders.
X-ray revealed fractures of left tibia and fibula.
Doctors at the orthopaedics department of KWH found that the plaintiff had suffered from fracture of the distal shaft of left tibia and fibula with two 1 cm wounds over the fracture.
Intramedullary nailing of the left tibia was performed on 21 August 2014.
Fracture left tibia and fibula healed with mild deformity;

injuries.description: contusion injury of both shoulders with soft tissue involvement
source: the plaintiff sustained multiple injuries, including injury to his left ankle, left leg and bilateral shoulders.
the plaintiff suffered from left leg fracture and soft tissue injury to both shoulders in the Accident.
The plaintiff also sustained contusion injury of both shoulders with soft tissue involvement in the Accident;
injuries.icd_description: Contusion of shoulder or upper arm

comparable_cases.case_name: Chan Shing Ching v Hong Kong District Security Ltd and Another
comparable_cases.injury_description: fracture at his right tibia and fibular; wound debridement and application of external skeletal fixator; later intramedullary nailing; admitted again for treatment of skin graft wound infection; confined to a wheelchair for 4 months; thereafter had to walk with a walking frame or walking sticks.

comparable_cases.case_name: Ko Chu Keung v Temmuk Engineering Co Ltd And Another
comparable_cases.injury_description: fracture of the right tibia and fibula with a 10 cm x 4 cm contaminated open wound; wound irrigation, IV antibiotics, skin traction; intramedullary nailing of the right tibia and plating of the right fibula; second debridement; implant and stitches removed.

comparable_cases.case_name: Sukhdeep Singh v Chow Kin Hung And Another
comparable_cases.injury_description: fractured distal tibia and fibula of right leg; open reduction and internal fixation of the fibula and nailing of the tibia; bone graft from right knee; re-admitted for removal of surgical implant due to continued pain.
